text.id:auto:site-davids-dell.html:section:4/: Campfires are welcome and Firewood is available to order, ready and waiting at your campsite when you arrive.   Total fire bans are observed.
text.id:auto:site-davids-dell.html:section:2/: Inside, a secluded canopy of trees and a soft floor of ferns wrap the site in complete privacy —  Made for small groups this site is especially popular with couples, and the solo camper
